captions.detailed: An airfield-scale advertising blimp featuring a large, grey, cigar-shaped envelope with a long red stripe along each side. Suspended underneath is a detailed gondola cabin, which supports twin side engine nacelles on short pylons. The tail features dark blue cruciform fins including vertical rudders and horizontal elevators. Structurally, the rudders and elevators rotate on their respective hinge axes, the engine pods pivot on their pylon mounts, and each propeller spins continuously.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of an advertising blimp. It should feature a streamlined grey envelope with side banner panels, a detailed lower gondola cabin, twin vectoring engine nacelles mounted on lateral pylons, and a cruciform tail assembly. Ensure the rudders, elevators, engine pods, and propellers are defined as separate articulated parts with correct rotational axes.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp starting with the envelope using a revolved profile or lofted shape. The gondola cabin is modeled from rounded boxes and cylinders, suspended below the main body. Lateral pylons are extruded to carry cylindrical engine pods, which are modeled with spinning propeller assemblies. The tail fins are built from extruded flat sketches, with separate movable control surfaces (rudders and elevators) attached via revolute joints on their hinge axes.
